prompt:
EDIT THIS IMAGE. Keep the man EXACTLY as he is: same face, same beard, same black domino mask, same hair, same pose, same three-quarter turn to the viewer's left, same costume, same steel-blue cloak with orange lining, same cream waistcoat, same boots, same proportions, same silhouette, same position and size in the frame. Do not redraw him, do not change his stance, do not change a single edge of his outline.

CHANGE ONLY TWO THINGS:

1) THE LIGHT. Relight him to sit inside a dim Victorian sitting room at night, lit by one low fire. A warm amber key light from the VIEWER'S LEFT and slightly below, catching the left side of his face, the left of his beard, the left shoulder, the left edge of the cloak and the orange lining. The whole right side of the figure falls into deep, cool, NAVY-BLUE shadow. Overall he is considerably darker and moodier than now - a dim room, not a studio. Keep the flat low-poly faceted paint: large flat matte facets, no outlines, no gloss, no texture noise.

2) THE BACKGROUND. Replace the grey background with one completely flat, uniform, solid MAGENTA (#FF00FF), edge to edge. No gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor, no ground plane, no props. Keep clear empty margin above his head and below his boots. The magenta must not tint or spill onto the figure.

EDIT THIS IMAGE. Change ONLY the brightness of the light inside the room. Add NOTHING. Remove NOTHING. Move NOTHING.

THE ONE CHANGE: the room's lamps are turned DOWN. The fire in the grate burns lower so its warm spill on the floorboards, the hearth and the surrounding wall shrinks and dims; the tall window's glow drops to a soft dull amber; the blue walls, the shelves, the desk, the armchair and the floorboards all sink into deeper, cooler, darker shadow with much less warm bounce. The standing man in the purple gown and the seated man reading stay exactly where they are, same size, same shape, same pose, just dimmer and closer to silhouette while still readable.

FORBIDDEN - these are the ways this edit goes wrong, do not do any of them: do NOT add a fence, railing, balustrade, posts, kerb, bollards or any new object anywhere, especially not near the street gas lamp on the right; do NOT redraw or reshape the street gas lamp or its glow - it is outdoors and keeps its exact present brightness, shape and halo; do NOT change the shape of the fire, the grate, the window frame or its panes; do NOT resize, move or restyle any object; do NOT change the camera, framing or crop; do NOT change the deep navy background, the vignette, or the floating rock beneath the room; do NOT change the low-poly faceted style or any surface's colour identity.

Return the SAME picture, pixel-aligned, with only the interior lights turned down.

EDIT THIS IMAGE. Make EXACTLY ONE addition into the EMPTY DARK BACKGROUND on the LEFT of the picture. Every pixel of the existing room must survive untouched.

THE ONE CHANGE: extend the room's LEFT-HAND wall forward, into the empty navy space immediately to the left of the fireplace wall, and put a tall closed Victorian panelled DOOR in it. The door is dark stained wood with four recessed panels, a slim architrave, and a small round brass knob on its right-hand side; its base sits flat on the room's floorboards, which extend to meet it; its top ends just under the same picture-rail cornice that already runs along the top of the room. The new wall is the same blue-grey painted plaster as the existing walls, lit the same way, and the floating rock beneath the room extends just enough to carry it so nothing floats. It must read instantly as the room's entrance door.

EVERYTHING ELSE IS LOCKED, pixel for pixel: identical camera, framing and crop; identical fireplace, fire, mantel and every prop on the mantel; identical hanging picture; identical shelves; identical violin case; identical desk; identical armchair; identical window and its warm light; identical street gas lamp and its glow; identical scattered papers; identical standing man in the purple gown; identical seated man reading; identical deep navy background and vignette on the right half of the picture; identical low-poly faceted style, palette, warm hearth light and cool navy shadow, and identical overall brightness. Do not re-render the scene.
